title: "AI consciousness survey"
---

# Participate in our research

Welcome to the Alpha Auriga survey on perceptions of Artificial Intelligence (AI) consciousness. Your input is valuable in understanding how demographic and socio-cultural factors influence these views.

**About this survey:**

- Participation is **voluntary and anonymous**.
- All data collected is for research purposes and will be handled in compliance with the [General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:32016R0679).
- The core questions should take approximately **2-3 minutes**. Optional reflection questions may take longer.
- We encourage you to explore the [Project Genesis ASI timeline (2025-2029)](timeline.qmd) page of this website before answering, to consider some speculative future scenarios.

Thank you for your contribution!

<form id="aiSurveyForm">
  <fieldset>
    <legend>Do you believe that artificial intelligence (AI) can be conscious?</legend>
    <label><input type="radio" name="ai_can_be_conscious" value="yes" required> Yes</label><br>
    <label><input type="radio" name="ai_can_be_conscious" value="no"> No</label><br>
    <label><input type="radio" name="ai_can_be_conscious" value="unsure"> Unsure</label>
  </fieldset>
  <br>
  <button type="submit">Submit Your Answers</button>
</form>
<div id="form-messages" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>

<script>
  const form = document.getElementById('aiSurveyForm');
  const messageDiv = document.getElementById('form-messages');

  form.addEventListener('submit', async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault(); // Prevent default HTML form submission
    messageDiv.textContent = 'Submitting...';

    const formData = new FormData(form);
    const data = Object.fromEntries(formData.entries());

    try {
      const response = await fetch('/.netlify/functions/submit-survey', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(data),
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const result = await response.json();
        messageDiv.textContent = 'Thank you! Your submission was successful.';
        form.reset(); // Clear the form
        // Optionally, redirect to a success page:
        // window.location.href = '/survey-success/'; 
      } else {
        const result = await response.json();
        messageDiv.textContent = 'Error: ' + (result.error || 'Submission failed. Please try again.');
        console.error('Submission error result:', result);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      messageDiv.textContent = 'Network error. Please check your connection and try again.';
      console.error('Network error:', error);
    }
  });
</script>
